import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return

    n = int(data[0])
    moves = (1 << n) - 1

    result = [str(moves)]

    def hanoi(k, start, mid, end):
        if k == 0:
            return
        if k == 1:
            result.append(f"{start} {end}")
            return

        hanoi(k - 1, start, end, mid)
        result.append(f"{start} {end}")
        hanoi(k - 1, mid, start, end)

    hanoi(n, 1, 2, 3)
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(result) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
